UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Represents an authenticated user's personal profile and e-learning role onboarding details synchronized with Firestore.

userId.description: The unique Firebase Auth UID of the profile owner.

displayName.description: The user's display name (1 to 100 characters).

email.description: The user's email address from Google Sign-In.

headline.description: Short professional or personal tagline (up to 160 characters).

bio.description: Detailed biography or about section (up to 1000 characters).

location.description: User's city, region, or country (up to 120 characters).

roleTitle.description: Current role, occupation, or title (up to 120 characters).

website.description: Personal website or portfolio link (up to 250 characters).

statusMessage.description: Current availability or status badge text (up to 160 characters).

photoUrl.description: URL to the user's profile avatar photo (up to 500 characters).

actorRole.description: Selected platform role (defaults to ADMIN for fokoufdr@gmail.com, VISITOR for all other users).

accountStatus.description: User account status managed by the administrator (ACTIVE by default; PENDING, SUSPENDED, or BLOCKED restrict navigation and profile actions).

onboardingCompleted.description: Whether the user has completed the post-signup role selection questionnaire.

educationSystem.description: Educational system for students or teachers (e.g., ANGLOPHONE, FRANCOPHONE, BILINGUAL).

studentLevel.description: Academic level for students (ORDINARY_LEVEL or ADVANCED_LEVEL).

studentStream.description: Academic specialization for students (SCIENCE or ART).

studentSeries.description: Selected academic series from the JSON curriculum (e.g., S1, S2, S3, S4, A1..A5, SERIE_C, SERIE_D, SERIE_TI, SERIE_A4; up to 100 characters).

selectedSubjects.description: Serialized pipe-separated list of subjects selected by the user from the JSON curriculum (up to 1200 characters).

schoolName.description: Selected or custom school name for students or school accounts (up to 200 characters).

schoolOwnership.description: Whether a school is PRIVATE or PUBLIC (up to 40 characters).

schoolAge.description: Age or years of existence of the school (up to 40 characters).

schoolEmail.description: Official contact email of the school (up to 200 characters).

schoolFacebookUrl.description: Facebook page URL of the school (up to 300 characters).

teachingYears.description: Number of years of teaching experience for teachers (up to 40 characters).

teacherSchools.description: Serialized list of schools where the teacher has taught (up to 500 characters).

pseudonym.description: Optional pseudonym for teachers wishing to remain anonymous (up to 100 characters).

phoneNumbers.description: Serialized list of optional phone numbers for teachers, schools, or parents (up to 500 characters).

childIds.description: Serialized list of 1 to 20 child IDs for parent accounts (up to 600 characters).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was first created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

AppActivity.title: AppActivity
AppActivity.description: Represents a logged user or system activity event within the app, viewable by the activity owner and administrators in the Admin Portal Dashboard.

activityId.description: Unique identifier for the activity document (1 to 128 characters).

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user who triggered the activity.

userDisplayName.description: Display name of the user who triggered the activity (1 to 100 characters).

userEmail.description: Email address of the user who triggered the activity (up to 200 characters).

eventType.description: Categorized type of the activity or database security event.

ipAddress.description: Client IP address associated with the database connection or request (up to 100 characters).

targetPath.description: Firestore collection or document path targeted by the operation (up to 200 characters).

dbStatus.description: Database operation outcome: ATTEMPT, SUCCESS, FAILURE, or INJECTION_BLOCKED (up to 60 characters).

title.description: Short summary title of the activity event (1 to 160 characters).

details.description: Detailed metadata or description of the activity (up to 1000 characters).

severity.description: Visual and operational severity level of the activity.

reviewStatus.description: Admin review status of the activity event.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the activity occurred via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the activity was created or last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

AdminRecord.title: AdminRecord
AdminRecord.description: Trusted administrator registry document keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

adminId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the administrator.

email.description: Verified email address of the administrator (1 to 200 characters).

grantedBy.description: UID of the administrator who provisioned this record.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when admin access was granted via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the admin record was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

CurriculumSubjectRecord.title: CurriculumSubjectRecord
CurriculumSubjectRecord.description: Represents a subject added by an administrator under a specific educational subsystem with full academic characteristics.

subjectId.description: Unique identifier for the curriculum subject.

code.description: Official or custom subject code (e.g., 0770, INFO-AI).

name.description: Full display name of the subject.

coefficient.description: Academic weight/coefficient of the subject (1 to 10).

category.description: Subject category (e.g., Compulsory, Principal, Core, Spécialité, Elective, Practical).

seriesCode.description: Series or combination code (e.g., S1, S2, A1, SERIE_C, SERIE_D, GENERAL).

description.description: Subject characteristics, syllabus summary, and exam structure.

createdByEmail.description: Email of the administrator who created the subject.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the subject was added.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the subject was last updated.

RevisionBafendDocument.title: RevisionBafendDocument
RevisionBafendDocument.description: Represents an admin-uploaded PDF revision document packaged with the proprietary .bafend extension for a specific subject.

docId.description: Unique identifier for the .bafend revision document.

title.description: Document title shown in the Revision Hub.

description.description: Summary of revision topics covered in the document.

subjectCode.description: Code of the subject this PDF belongs to.

subjectName.description: Name of the subject this PDF belongs to.

subjectCategory.description: Category of the subject (e.g., Principal, Compulsory).

originalPdfName.description: Original uploaded PDF filename before conversion.

bafendFileName.description: Assigned filename with the mandatory .bafend extension.

pageCount.description: Total number of pages in the .bafend PDF document.

fileSizeBytes.description: Size of the .bafend file in bytes.

bafendBase64Payload.description: Base64-encoded .bafend file binary payload for cross-device download and offline caching.

uploadedByEmail.description: Administrator email who uploaded the PDF.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores isolated user profile and role onboarding documents keyed by the authenticated Firebase Auth UID, readable by the owner or an administrator.

/activities/{activityId}.description: Stores application-wide activity audit events created by authenticated users and monitored globally in the Admin Portal Dashboard.

/admins/{adminId}.description: Stores trusted administrator role documents keyed by Firebase Auth UID.

/curriculum_subjects/{subjectId}.description: Stores admin-created curriculum subjects under any subsystem with their characteristics.

/revision_documents/{docId}.description: Stores admin-uploaded PDF revision documents assigned the .bafend extension for browsing and offline download.
